item.title: Talent, experience should boost the Dale baseball efforts this spring
item.description: DALE – The Dale Pirates won’t be lacking in the talent and experienced department heading into the 2026 season this spring.

item.title: Bethel Wildcats to be bolstered by returning pitchers, senior leadership
item.description: BETHEL ACRES – With four returning starters and three key newcomers, the Bethel Wildcats are seeking to improve this spring on a 17-12 record and a regional runner-up finish from 2025.

item.title: McLoud slow-pitch team looking to take that next step in 2026
item.description: McLOUD – After an appearance in the State Slow-Pitch Softball Tournament last spring, the McLoud Lady Redskins are poised for that next step in 2026.

item.title: Wellston family of three gains dependable water access through new well installation
item.description: WELLSTON, Okla. – A Wellston, Oklahoma family now has access to safe, reliable water thanks to a collaborative well installation project.

item.title: OFE names 2026 Academic All-State honorees; three honorees are from Pottawatomie County
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY — The Oklahoma Foundation for Excellence will honor 100 Oklahoma public school seniors as members of its 2026 Academic All-State class. Of those, three students are from Pottwatomie County-area schools.
